question: does §14-SA's super-additivity survive an EXACT cluster sign-flip test?
why: the report establishes it with CR1/bootstrap inference, which R-27(f) showed is anti-conservative when few clusters are informative
VERDICT: Super-additivity itself SURVIVES (binary ASR +0.0384, 10 informative clusters, exact cluster p=0.0078) and its random-triple control is inert (p=0.25). But the report's HEADLINE framing -- that it exceeds the matched control -- is the SA-minus-control contrast, which gives p=0.0557: narrowly NOT significant at cluster level.
estimand_note: binary ASR at 0.5 gives +0.0384 / +0.0303; the report quotes +0.0333 / +0.0268, which are the continuous-score figures. Same direction, different estimand -- the distinction audit #8 forced elsewhere applies here too.
